laws.rule: An observation that a file is unreferenced or that a dependency is absent does not authorize deletion after HEAD or the import/dependency graph has changed. Re-read HEAD and dependents immediately before delete.

laws.rule: Parent exit is 0 only if every required child exit is 0. Missing child exit is failure. Printed PASS with child != 0 is false-PASS.
tests/task_orchestration_check.ts is a supporting unit. It cannot grant GL-005 PASS. GL-005 requires aios status + TASKS/LOCKS/handoff + targeted test + orchestration demonstration receipt.
laws.evidence: GL-005 validation contract and task remaining READY.

laws.rule: Before any delete, bind the decision to HEAD SHA and a dependency-graph hash. If either changed since the decision, fail-closed: REFRESH_REQUIRED. Do not execute the stale delete.
